# Banner and collage design

**Make her 3:1 banners and photo collages — silver foil, the club, the looks collage — and export every platform size.**

Designs and exports profile banners and photo collages for an AI influencer — Claudia's 3:1 silver-foil banner with a silver script wordmark, the club platform banner, and the silver photo-collage banner of her looks — with full prompts per model, composition for each platform's crop and safe area (X 1500×500, YouTube 2560×1440 with the 1546×423 safe area, LinkedIn 1584×396, Twitch 1200×480, Discord, site 3:1 at 2000/1200/800), ffmpeg crop/collage/overlay/export commands, licensed-font wordmarks added in the edit step, and trademark-safe handling of platform and chain logos. Use when making or refreshing a header, channel art, website hero banner, collage, or any wide composite image.

## How it works

1. Choose the banner and its master format
2. Compose for the crops before you prompt
3. Silver-foil banner
4. Club platform banner
5. Add wordmarks and logos in the edit step
6. Crop and export every size
7. YouTube needs its own composition
8. Looks collage banner
9. Review at real size

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/banner-and-collage-design.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/banner-and-collage-design.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/banner-and-collage-design.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/banner-and-collage-design.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill banner-and-collage-design`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `banner-and-collage-design.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/banner-and-collage-design`.
